description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Order to impose Special Commodity Levy on Mackerel, Peas, Seeds etc., for a 6 months period w.e.f. 08.03.2018
reasoning: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It establishes new regulatory requirements and tax rates for specific commodities, which falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a government minister (Eran Wickramaratne), it does so only to establish the authority for the regulatory action and does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it primarily a regulatory announcement rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
